items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: I guess it's Prader. I'll tell you why they called him Ragbag Stevens. He never looked good.

ctx.x: Why did they call him Ragbag Stevens? I guess it's Prader. I'll tell you why they called him Ragbag Stevens. He never looked good. Huh? He never looked neat.
